items.summary: Application IntegrationSecurityAn Incorrect Authorization vulnerability in the AuthConfigvalidation and integration execution runtime in Application Integrationversions prior to August 27, 2026.For more information, see theGCP-2026-068security bulletin.Certificate ManagerChangeGoogle-managed public SSL certificates signed by Google PublicCA (pki.goog) are gradually transitioning from a90-day validity period to a 45-day validity period to improve security.To align with modern industry-wide security standards and promote shortercertificate lifespans, Google-managed public certificates now rotate morefrequently. This proactive rotation enhances the overall security posture ofload balancers. The transition requires no manual intervention or configurationchanges as Certificate Manager automatically manages both issuance and renewal.For more information, see Google-managedcertificatesand Use Google-managedcertificates.
